fullPassage: In today's information age, in many companies and on many teams, the weights of individual capabilities and contributions have shifted. The knowledge used to do many jobs is now less private, harder to keep secret. Whereas in the past, authority derived naturally from mastery of information, today many people have access to the same sources. If knowledge is still power, it is a kind of power that is more widely shared. Consistent and repeatable processes and outputs are important, but they are not sufficient to stay competitive. Consistency and repeatability are more likely to suppress fresh thinking than to encourage it. In this knowledge economy, people who are merely managers — people who are primarily monitors of others' work — are of less value to a company than those who think of new ways to do things.

det.korean: ① 지식 경제에서 새 방법을 생각하는 사람이 관리자보다 가치 있다 = 창의적 사고 중요성
det.analysis:
✅ ① 창의적 사고 중요성 — 글의 핵심 주장 ←정답
❌ ② 부정적 영향이 아닌 변화 서술
❌ ③ 관리 전략이 아닌 관리자의 한계 서술
❌ ④ 정보 보안이 아닌 정보 공유 서술
det.tip: think of new ways > merely managers

ch: 지식 경제 시대에 창의적 사고의 중요성 증대
정보 기술 발전이 기업 문화에 미친 부정적 영향
효율적인 팀 관리를 위한 리더십 전략
기업 내 정보 보안의 필요성과 방법

questions.passage: In today's information age, in many companies and on many teams, the weights of individual capabilities and contributions have shifted. The knowledge used to do many jobs is now less private, harder to keep secret. Whereas in the past, authority derived naturally from mastery of information, today many people have access to the same sources. If knowledge is still power, it is a kind of power that is more widely shared. Consistent and repeatable processes and outputs are important, but they are not sufficient to stay competitive. Consistency and repeatability are more likely to suppress fresh thinking than to encourage it. In this knowledge economy, people who are merely managers — people who are primarily monitors of others' work — are of less value to a company than those who think of new ways to do things.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 지식 공유 시대 + 단순 관리 < 혁신 = 글의 결론
det.analysis:
❌ ① 정보 제한이 아닌 공유 강조
❌ ② 일관성은 충분하지 않다고 함
❌ ③ 관리자는 덜 가치 있다고 함
✅ ④ 혁신적 사고 > 단순 관리 — 글의 핵심 ←정답
det.tip: people who think of new ways > merely managers
